      "searchQueries": [
        "hard drive with shield icon",
        "data packets moving on network lines",
        "shield protecting database storage"

      "onScreenText": "اختر الحماية المناسبة الآن",
      "visualIntent": "Developer smiling confidently pointing to a checklist with two green checkmarks next to 'At Rest' and 'In Transit'.",
      "searchQueries": [
        "developer checking security checklist",
        "green checkmarks on database diagram",
        "secure connection icon animation"
      ]
    }
  ],
